remarks: Prepare to be impressed by this exquisitely renovated & beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in Stamford's prestigious Buckingham Condominium. Spanning 1,752 sqft, this spacious unit offers the perfect layout & features for modern living. Step into a welcoming foyer that opens to a sun-filled LR with oversized windows & sliding doors. The dining area is ideal for entertaining, the private balcony offers stunning views and sunsets. The updated eat-in kitchen boasts granite countertops & top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, perfect for both family meals & holiday feasts. The elegant Primary Bedroom features custom-built closets, a marble-topped storage chest, plus a luxurious spa-like bath with a heated towel rack & a vanity w/lighted mirrors. The walk-in closet offers abundant storage space for all your belongings. The marble guest bath is equally impressive, w/a heated bubble/air tub, tin sink, & marble floors & counters. The second Bedroom is spacious & versatile, ideal for guests, family, or a home office. This unit is a storage dream, w/amazing closets, hardwood floors, an in-unit washer/dryer, two deeded garage spaces, five storage lockers. The Buckingham offers top-notch amenities, including 24-hour doorman services, gated parking, in-ground heated pool, gym w/sauna, & a community/party room w/ a full kitchen. Relax in the lounge area with a large screen TV, library, conference room, & patio terrace. Experience downtown living at its finest.
